H1.title: Minutes trend: when his last 3 games averaged 4+ minutes off his usual, project him at his last-3 minutes
H1.label: input fix
H1.notes: From the misses log: calls leaning into a player running above his usual minutes went 6 of 7 (Oct 26-27), but that used the minutes he went on to play. This is the pre-tip version: recent minutes over the usual (the morning file's last 10). It can't fire until players have 5+ games, when the two differ

H2.title: Blowout trim (the board's NBA_BLOWOUT): a 30+ minute player whose team is favored by 10+ projects 1 point lower
H2.label: situational
H2.notes: Built into the board's morning Proj (off once ETR's file is in). Scored against the base plus the matchup term, as the board applies it. Re-run of the study (2023-26): favorite stars lose 1 min at 10-12.5 and 2.5-3 at 13+, mostly won back per minute; net of the opponent about -0.5/-1.0 at 10-12.5 and -0.9/-2.2 at 13+ (fit/test). See blowout_study.md

H3.title: Underdog bench: a player under 20 usual minutes whose team is a 10+ point underdog projects 2 points higher
H3.label: situational
H3.notes: The most consistent effect in the blowout study: +1.4 to +3.3 FP and +2 to +3.5 min at 10+ (fit 2023-25 and test 2025-26); this season so far +2.5 against ETR (n 74). Scored against the base plus the matchup term

H4.title: Blowout slide: as H2, but -1 at 10-12.5 and -2 at 13+
H4.label: situational
H4.notes: The study's open question: net of the opponent the 13+ favorites ran -0.9 (fit) and -2.2 (test). Read against H2 on the same players; it only differs at 13+
